candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout; the fault originates in the order service, not the gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within order (db, payment, inventory) is not established; only the failing hop is bounded.

report.explanation: Traces and logs consistently show gateway POST /v1/checkout returning 502 immediately after a downstream POST /v1/orders returning 500 from the order service, with short durations (~15-60ms) ruling out latency. Gateway /readyz and /healthz are healthy. The bounded cause is an order-service 500; the specific internal fault is not yet evidenced.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for POST /v1/orders to identify the internal 500 cause
Order dependency metrics (postgresql, payment, inventory) to rule out db-pool-exhaustion or downstream-latency
